Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD) does not have a default configuration for user sign-in frequency. Admins can set it manually in each tenant, and there is no built-in reset or review feature for it. Disabling the feature leaves the tenant unchanged.

The Intune management agent checks in every 24 hours by default on macOS devices. This interval can be adjusted between 1 and 86400 seconds in the device configuration policy.

In Microsoft Entra (formerly Azure Active Directory), you can configure up to 20 named locations per tenant. Named locations help determine the eligibility of users for conditional access policies based on their physical or virtual location. Once the limit is reached, you can't create more named locations in that tenant.

Microsoft Defender for Endpoint retains data for the duration of the evaluation period for each tenant. Retention policies can be configured per tenant, and the default is 180 days for most data.
